📺 The Good Wife (2009–2016)

The Good Wife follows Alicia Florrick, a devoted wife and mother who returns to her career as a defense attorney after her husband, a prominent politician, becomes involved in a public scandal. Determined to rebuild her life and provide for her family, Alicia joins a prestigious Chicago law firm, where she faces challenging cases, intense courtroom battles, and complicated professional relationships. As she grows more confident and independent, she must navigate political corruption, personal betrayals, and difficult choices involving love, loyalty, and ambition. With gripping legal drama, unexpected twists, and powerful performances, The Good Wife explores justice, marriage, family, and the strength it takes to start over.

🎭 Genre: Legal Drama • Crime • Political Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Robert King & Michelle King

🏆 Awards: Winner of five Primetime Emmy Awards.

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.
